assertions.name: form_a_two_term_qed_cartan_weightings_span_148_to_110_ppb_on_mn
assertions.source: On Form-A + 2tQED at q_2t, m_n residual spans +148.563 ppb ('plain', -331.70 eV) to +109.737 ppb ('q', -368.18 eV)

description: 80-dps parameter-free evaluation of the Convention-D Wedderburn / Jucys-Murphy / mirror-covariant ladder phase functionals alpha_Wed(q) (qou-q2oa), propagation of the two-term QED proton pin q_{2t} into m_p, m_mu, Q_beta, and m_n across 4 bases and 4 Cartan QED weightings, and exact eV/ppb error budget (qou-cds1, qou-j1e5).
caveats: All evaluated phase functionals, bases, substrate pins, and Cartan QED weightings are parameter-free algebraic/trigonometric functions of q at 80 dps (zero fitted parameters, zero float64).
q0AnchorReason: Deliberately compares 1-term proton, 2-term Borromean proton (plain and Kp), and CODATA-2022 muon pins across Wedderburn phase functionals and Q_beta/m_n.
